strings.i-dup.prompt: Which planet is the closest to the Sun?
strings.i-dup.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
strings.i-dup.o.venus.why: Venus is the hottest planet, not the closest.
strings.i-iskey.o.mars2.why: This is Mars written in capitals.
strings.i-one-a.prompt: What colour is the sky on a clear day?

strings.i-one-b.prompt: Which colour is the daytime sky?
strings.i-one-b.o.red.why: Red is the colour of a sunset.
